title: Cyrus and the Vector
author: Noor Ishikawa
blurb: Silas Joubert, the last human technician on an automated relay station, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
